# The Code Less Taken

> Writing about overlooked languages, systems, and techniques.

## Core pages

- [Home](https://thecodelesstaken.com/): Recent articles and contact information.
- [Writing](https://thecodelesstaken.com/writing/): All published articles.

## Editorial standards

- [Editorial method](https://thecodelesstaken.com/standards/editorial/): Topic selection, evidence, comparison, uncertainty, and corrections.
- [Corrections policy](https://thecodelesstaken.com/standards/corrections/): How corrections are submitted, evaluated, and recorded.
- [Privacy](https://thecodelesstaken.com/standards/privacy/): Site data and privacy practices.

## Feeds and discovery

- [RSS feed](https://thecodelesstaken.com/feed.xml): New posts.
- [XML sitemap](https://thecodelesstaken.com/sitemap.xml): Canonical public URLs.
